display.title: Trial of the Tides
description: A Gateways to Eternity trial: 3 fixed waves, fixed enemy counts, a visible timer.
Cost: 1x ancient core, 4x tidebound doubloon, 2x prismarine crystals (+ ender pearl).
Rewards: affix gear, gems and XP - never relics. Fight it in the open, away from your base.
&7Completes when you are within 48 blocks of the gate as its last wave falls.
